title: Paris in the spring
description: A dialogue lesson on the present perfect tense (have/has been to). George and Ken meet outside a cinema; Ken has just been to the cinema to see 'Paris in the Spring', a film George has already seen on television. Ken says Paris is a beautiful city, but the weather was awful — it rained all the time, just like London. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions and a fill-in exercise with to/to the, on/on the, and in phrases. Grammar exercises practise do/did/done, giving replies to telephone calls, and completing present-perfect dialogues.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (At what time of year did Ken visit Paris) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (comprehension) 10 items are taken from the supplied Lesson 85 key (img/key-085-090.jpg). Practice B (fill in with to, to the, on, on the, in) 8 blanks are taken from the same key. Grammar I (complete with do/did/done) 9 items are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 516-517). Grammar II (give correct replies) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the grammar key. Grammar III (write correct questions or answers) items 1.a and 2.a are printed examples; the remaining 10 items are taken from the grammar key. No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question.
At what time of year did Ken visit Paris?
听录音，然后回答问题。肯是在什么季节访问巴黎的？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording, then answer: At what time of year did Ken visit Paris?

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: Have you just been to the cinema?
lines.translation: 乔治：你刚去过电影院吗？

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text:
Oh, I've already seen it.
I saw it
on television last year.
It's an old film, but it's very good.
lines.translation: 乔治：噢，我已看过了。我是去年在电视上看的。这是部老片子，但很好。

lines.speaker: KEN
lines.translation: 肯：巴黎是座美丽的城市。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text:
I've never been there.
Have you ever been there, Ken?
lines.translation: 乔治：我从未去过。肯，你去过吗？

lines.speaker: KEN
lines.text:
Yes, I have.
I was there in April.
lines.translation: 肯：是的，我去过。4月份我在那儿。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.translation: 乔治：那是巴黎之春，是吗？

lines.speaker: KEN
lines.text:
It was spring,
but the weather was awful.
It rained all the time.
lines.translation: 肯：是春天，但天气太糟了。一直在下雨。

lesson.title: Listening — answer the question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. At what time of year did Ken visit Paris? 听录音，然后回答问题。肯是在什么季节访问巴黎的？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue.

questions.prompt: At what time of year did Ken visit Paris?
questions.answer: In spring. (He was there in April.)

items.text: have been to ...，到过……。“到过那里”则说 have been there。注意，在这里我们讲 to the cinema，同时也说 to the park，但在第55课中，我们有 to work, to school 的短语。在名词 school, work, church 之前不加定冠词 the。
What's on? 上演什么电影？
eh /eɪ/，感叹词，在此表示疑问。读升调。

Just like London!
这是省略句，完整的句子为 Paris was just like London。其中的 just 有“正好”、“恰恰是”的意思。
而在第3行的 Have you just been to ... 中 just 是指时间，有“刚才”的意思。

lesson.text:
参考译文
乔治：你好，肯。
肯：你好，乔治。
乔治：你刚去过电影院吗？
肯：是的，我刚去过。
乔治：上映什么片子？
肯：《巴黎之春》。
乔治：噢，我已看过了。我是去年在电视上看的。这是部老片子，但很好。
肯：巴黎是座美丽的城市。
乔治：我从未去过。肯，你去过吗？
肯：是的，我去过。4月份我在那儿。
乔治：那是巴黎之春，是吗？
肯：是春天，但天气太糟了。一直在下雨。
乔治：就像伦敦一样！

practice.title: A — Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 173 and answer these questions. 参见学生用书第173页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: Answer each comprehension question about the lesson dialogue.
practice.context: Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 85 key (img/key-085-090.jpg).

questions.prompt: 1. Has Ken just been to the office?
questions.answer: No, he hasn't.

questions.prompt: 2. Where has he just been?
questions.answer: He's just been to the cinema.

questions.prompt: 3. What's on at the cinema?
questions.answer: Paris in the Spring.

questions.prompt: 4. Has George already seen it?
questions.answer: Yes, he has.

questions.prompt: 5. When did he see it?
questions.answer: He saw it on television last year.

questions.prompt: 6. Is Paris an awful city?
questions.answer: No, it isn't. It's a beautiful city.

questions.prompt: 7. Has George ever been to Paris?
questions.answer: No, he hasn't.

questions.prompt: 8. Has Ken ever been there?
questions.answer: Yes, he has.

questions.prompt: 9. When was Ken in Paris?
questions.answer: He was there in April.

questions.prompt: 10. What was the weather like?
questions.answer: It was awful. It rained all the time.

practice.title: B — To, to the, on, on the
practice.instruction:
Look at these phrases with the prepositions to, on and in. And notice where we use the. 请看含有 to, on 和 in 的介词短语。注意以下介词短语中 the 的用法。

Phrases: to the cinema / to the park / to work / to school / to church / to college / on television / on the radio / on holiday / on Monday / on 1st June / in London / in Paris / in spring / in autumn / in April / in 1975

Now fill the blanks with to, to the, on, on the or in. 填空。
practice.translation: Choose the correct preposition (to, to the, on, on the or in) for each blank.
practice.context: Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 85 key (img/key-085-090.jpg).

questions.prompt: 1. I heard the news about the terrible weather in India ______ radio.
questions.answer: on the

questions.prompt: 2. We went ______ cinema yesterday evening.
questions.answer: to the

questions.prompt: 3. They had a party for his birthday ______ 3rd August.
questions.answer: on

questions.prompt: 4. Ken was in Paris ______ April.
questions.answer: in

questions.prompt: 5. Last year we went ______ holiday in February.
questions.answer: on

questions.prompt: 6. They usually go ______ church on Sunday.
questions.answer: to

questions.prompt: 7. There was an interesting programme about Paris ______ television last night.
questions.answer: on

questions.prompt: 8. I've just been ______ park for a walk.
questions.answer: to the

grammar.title: I. Complete the sentences, using "do", "did" or "done". 用 do, did 或 done 完成下列各句。
grammar.instruction: Complete each sentence with "do", "did" or "done". 用 do, did 或 done 完成下列各句。
grammar.translation: Fill each blank with the correct form: do, did or done.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=501
grammar.context: Answers are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 516-517).

questions.prompt: 1. What are you going to ______ with that piece of cloth?
questions.answer: do

questions.prompt: 2. What are you going to ______ in the holidays?
questions.answer: do

questions.prompt: 3. What did you ______ yesterday?
questions.answer: do

questions.prompt: 4. What have you ______ with the vase?
questions.answer: done

questions.prompt: 5. They ______ a lot of work yesterday.
questions.answer: did

questions.prompt: 6. You have ______ your homework, and I have ______ my homework, too.
questions.answer: done, done

questions.prompt: 7. ______ you have a good time at the party last week?
questions.answer: Did

questions.prompt: 8. ______ you watch television every night? Yes, I ______.
questions.answer: Do, do

questions.prompt: 9. Have you ______ yesterday's homework? Yes, I ______ it last night.
questions.answer: done, did

grammar.title: II. Give correct replies to the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。

Example: 1. May I speak to Mr. Smith? (the newsagent's) → Yes, of course. He's been to the newsagent's, but he's here now.
